diagram_previews.alt: A grey regular octagon with bottom side 20 inside a large square fence; the dog's tie point V is the bottom-right corner of the octagon. A yellow region bounded by an orange arc of radius 37 about V and two small sectors of radius 17 about the neighbouring corners surrounds the lower part of the octagon. A double arrow marks the distance 30 from the bottom side of the octagon to the bottom side of the fence, and the part of the radius-37 region below the fence is shaded pink.
